title: A2UI Conformance Test Suite Schema
description: JSON schema validating all A2UI conformance test suites across core, agent, and extensions domains.

name.description: Unique name of the test case.

action.description: The conformance test action to perform.

description.description: Optional description of what the test verifies.

catalogs.description: List of catalog objects for multi-catalog or processor tests.

catalogPaths.description: List of file paths to catalog schema JSON files.

catalogPath.description: File path to catalog schema JSON file.

input.description: Primary input for parser and single-step execution tests.

messages.description: A2UI message array or container object.

payload.description: A2UI message array or container object (alias for messages).

args.description: Execution arguments for the test action.

strictMode.description: Whether strict validation mode is enabled.

disableValidation.description: Whether validation is explicitly disabled for the test.

steps.description: Sequential steps for multi-step execution tests.

expect.description: Expected outcome of the test action (evaluated as a contains / subset match rather than an exact match).

expectContains.description: Expected substrings or sub-objects in the output.

expectEmpty.description: Whether output is expected to be empty.

useBasicCatalog.description: Whether to use the standard basic catalog implementation.

expectFile.description: File path to JSON file containing expected outcome object.

initial.description: Initial contents of the data model. Defaults to an empty object.

watch.description: Paths observed for the duration of the case. A path may repeat to attach more than one observer.

expected_file.description: File path to file containing expected text or markdown content.

expected_skills.description: List of expected skill filenames or keys.

protocolVersion.description: Protocol version supported by this catalog.

components.description: Map of component names to component schema definitions.

s2cSchema.description: Legacy parser server-to-client schema path or object.

catalogSchema.description: Legacy parser catalog schema path or object.

commonTypesSchema.description: Legacy parser common types schema path or object.

customCuttableKeys.description: Custom cuttable keys for streaming parser.

name.description: Name or identifier of the catalog config.

path.description: File path to the catalog schema JSON.

payload.description: Payload or messages for this step.

value.description: Value to write. Only meaningful for set.

expect.description: Expected output for this step (evaluated as a contains / subset match rather than an exact match).

expectContains.description: Expected substrings or sub-objects for this step.

expect_absent.description: Whether the path is expected to hold no value. Only meaningful for get.

expect_type.description: Structural type the path is expected to hold. Only meaningful for get.

expect_values.description: Value each watched path holds after this step, keyed by path.

expect_notified.description: Watched paths whose observers fired for this step, one entry per observer that fired.

axeCore.description: List of axe-core rule IDs expected to pass.

AgentCatalogRef.description: A catalog document, either a path relative to `conformance/` or the document inlined in the case.

oneOf.description: Path to a catalog document, relative to `conformance/`.

CatalogTransformerSpec.description: One transformer, in the order it is applied. A case states the allowlist directly. Keeping everything is said by leaving the transformer out, so an empty allowlist keeps nothing.

component_pruning.description: The component names a ComponentPruningTransformer keeps.

function_pruning.description: The function names a FunctionPruningTransformer keeps.

CatalogRegistration.description: A catalog as the agent registers it, which is a CatalogConfig: the pristine document plus the transformers applied before it reaches a prompt or a validator.

InferenceFormatName.description: The inference format strategy the case exercises.

CatalogExpectation.description: Assertions about one catalog. Each is optional, so a case states only what it means to check. The name lists are exhaustive: the catalog declares those names and no others.

protocol_version.description: The protocol version the catalog reports, written as the enum spells it, such as `v1.0`.

RawResponsePart.description: One token of an unwrapped response: conversational text or an uncompiled A2UI block, never both.

a2ui_raw.description: The uncompiled format content between the sentinel tags, as a RawA2uiPart.

is_final.description: Whether the part is closed. A block the model left unterminated states false.

ResponsePart.description: One part of a parsed response: conversational text or compiled A2UI messages, never both. This is the union the blueprint parser returns, so text that precedes a payload is its own part rather than a field on the payload's part.

TransformCatalogTest.description: Applying catalog transformers to a pristine catalog.

ProvideCatalogTest.description: Loading a catalog document through a catalog provider, including the identity and version checks the provider performs.

provider.description: Which provider loads the document. Only the file system provider is covered: an in memory provider is handed a document that a case would have to inline, which tests the harness that inlined it more than the provider.

path.description: Path relative to `conformance/`, for the file system provider.

catalog_id.description: The id the provider is constructed with. It is checked against the document only when the document states one, and supplies the id when the document does not.

protocol_version.description: The protocol version the provider is constructed with, checked against the document only when the document states one.

ResolveCatalogsTest.description: Negotiating renderer capabilities against the catalogs an agent registered, and returning the transformed catalogs that are active for the session.

catalogs.description: The catalogs the agent registered, in registration order.

renderer_capabilities.description: The capabilities object as it arrives on the wire, keyed by protocol version. A case for a request that carries no capabilities at all leaves this out.

accepts_inline_catalogs.description: Whether the agent accepts catalogs the renderer declares inline.

active_catalog_ids.description: The ids of the active catalogs, compared without regard to order. Nothing in the protocol gives the sequence a meaning, so a harness compares these as a set.

catalogs.description: Assertions about each active catalog, matched to `active_catalog_ids` by `catalog_id` rather than by position.

GeneratePromptSnippetTest.description: Rendering the system prompt snippet for a format and a set of active catalogs. Assertions are substrings rather than whole texts, because the wording around the catalog is an implementation's own.

examples.description: Prompt examples, each a path relative to `conformance/` to a JSON file holding the AgentToRendererMessage list for one turn.

allowed_messages.description: The payload envelope names the format may describe, such as `createSurface`. Leaving it out means every envelope of the protocol version is available.

expect_absent.description: Substrings the snippet must not carry, which is how a case checks that a pruned component never reaches the model.

expect_deterministic.description: Generating twice from the same inputs returns the same string.

UnwrapTest.description: Tokenizing a model response into ordered raw parts, before any payload is compiled.

input.description: The raw text the model emitted.

expect.description: The parts in the order the model emitted them.

WrapTest.description: Writing raw parts back out as a model would have emitted them, which is how examples and transcripts are produced.

expect_output.description: The exact string, for cases where the spelling is fixed by the format.

expect_round_trip.description: Unwrapping the output returns the parts the case supplied.

CompileTest.description: Compiling one raw format block into A2UI messages.

catalogs.description: For cases where the compiler needs more than one active catalog.

input.description: The raw block content, without the sentinel tags.

expect_present.description: JSON Pointers into the compiled messages that must hold a non-empty value whose spelling is not fixed by the protocol. A harness removes each of these from what the implementation produced, asserting on the way that it was there and not empty, and then compares what is left against `expect`. The `expect` block therefore omits them. This is for a value the format has to supply but the protocol does not dictate, such as the message on a check that was written without one.

DecompileTest.description: Writing A2UI messages back into a format's own notation.

messages.description: The AgentToRendererMessage objects to write out.

expect_round_trip.description: Compiling the output returns the messages the case supplied.

ParseResponseTest.description: Parsing a whole model response into the text and payload parts an agent hands on, in the order the model emitted them.

wrapped.description: Whether the response is expected to carry sentinel tags. A case with false hands the whole body to the compiler.

ParseChunkTest.description: Feeding a response to a parser one chunk at a time. Each step states the parts that chunk yields, so a case fixes both what is emitted and when.

progressive_keys.description: Overrides the parser's default set of string keys that may be closed early while a value is still arriving.

input.description: The chunk handed to the parser.

expect.description: The parts this chunk yields, which is the delta since the previous chunk and is empty when the parser is still buffering.

expect_matches_single_shot.description: Concatenating the chunks and parsing them in one call yields the same parts as the steps do together, so chunk boundaries change timing and nothing else.

CreateFormatTest.description: Building an inference format from its factory and checking what the format hands back.

examples.description: Prompt examples, each a path relative to `conformance/` to a JSON file holding the AgentToRendererMessage list for one turn.

probe_chunks.description: A stream fed to one parser and then to a second parser built by the same format, which is how a case checks that the two share no buffer.

parsers_are_distinct.description: Two calls to create a parser return two parsers rather than one shared instance.

parser_state_isolated.description: A parser built after another has consumed `probe_chunks` produces the same parts from those chunks as the first one did.

CreateProcessorTest.description: Taking an agent's registered catalogs and a renderer's capabilities through to a request processor, and using that processor for a turn.

catalogs.description: The catalogs the generator holds for the life of the agent.

examples.description: Prompt examples held by the generator and checked against the active catalogs when a processor is created. Each is a path relative to `conformance/` to a JSON file holding the AgentToRendererMessage list for one turn.

format_override.description: A format passed when the processor is created, overriding the generator's own.

catalogs.description: Assertions about each active catalog, aligned by position with `active_catalog_ids`, for cases that check what the processor holds rather than what its prompt says.

generator_catalogs_unchanged.description: The generator's own catalogs are the same after the processor was created as before, so one renderer's negotiation cannot affect the next.

then_parse.description: A response parsed through the processor the case just created, for rules that only hold once negotiation has narrowed the catalogs. This sits beside `expect` rather than inside it because it is a call made on the processor, not a property read off it.

ExpectError.description: Expected error specification (error message string, regex, or structured error object).
